usage: demo [-h] [-v] [-o FILE] [--format {json,yaml,toml}] [--retries N]
            [--include PATTERN [PATTERN ...]] [--workdir DIR] [--[no-]color]
            source [dest]

A synthetic argparse-style command used to pin down parser behaviour.

positional arguments:
  source                Input file to process
  dest                  Where to write the result

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --verbose         Increase verbosity; may be given multiple times
  -o FILE, --output FILE
                        Write output to FILE instead of stdout
  --format {json,yaml,toml}
                        Serialisation format (default: json)
  --retries N           Number of retry attempts (default: 3)
  --include PATTERN [PATTERN ...]
                        Only process matching entries
  --workdir DIR         Run inside DIR
  --[no-]color          Toggle coloured output
  --threshold FLOAT     Similarity cutoff
